scope: Authoritative semantic-authoring overlay for the frozen Phase 3C 150-item batch. This file contains learner-facing Chinese glosses and example pairs only; exact French sense selection remains frozen upstream.

authoring_provenance.policy: Author content record-by-record from the frozen exact French sense. Do not use POS templates or sibling senses.
